title: China's generative AI measures
summary: The filing and content regime that governs public generative AI services in China.
bodyHtml:
What This Is

Interim Measures for the Management of Generative AI Services took effect on 15 August 2023. They require providers of services to the Chinese public to file algorithms, undergo a security assessment where required, and ensure training data and outputs comply with content rules. A labelling regime for AI-generated content took effect on 1 September 2025. The practical effect is that consumer-facing model services operate under licence, while enterprise and open-weight distribution sit in a greyer zone.

Status

Attribute Value
Development stage Mass production
Estimated window 2023–2026
Confidence label Confirmed
Evidence Editorial synthesis of company, agency and press reporting
Compiled 18 November 2026

Related records

Investment Exposure

For foreign firms, the regime makes China a separate product line with its own model, data and content review, not an extension of a global API.

What Would Change The View

  • Enforcement against open-weight redistribution.
  • Whether filing becomes a de facto market-entry barrier.
  • Cross-border data rules for enterprise deployments.

Record Notes

Editorial brief, not an imported source note. Named milestones are drawn from company, agency and press reporting; forward dates are announced targets, not verified outcomes. No figure here is an audited statistic.
